CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  parent_id TEXT,
  branched_from TEXT REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New Session',
  trigger TEXT,
  trigger_idempotency_key TEXT,
  routine_id TEXT,
  channel_route_key TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle',
  harness_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'v1',
  system_prompt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  permission_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guard',
  permission TEXT,
  context_window TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  queued_messages TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  steering_messages TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  cwd TEXT NOT NULL,
  suspension TEXT,
  tool_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  active_tab_target_id TEXT,
  browser_binding TEXT,
  incognito INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ephemeral INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  runtime_config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  read_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()),
  latest_compaction_message_offset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  archived_at INTEGER,
  pinned_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())
);

CREATE TABLE routines (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, type TEXT NOT NULL, environment TEXT NOT NULL, device_id TEXT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL, prompt TEXT NOT NULL, rrule TEXT NOT NULL,
      parent_session_id TEXT, project_id TEXT, channel_id TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL, next_run_at TEXT, paused_at INTEGER, deleted_at INTEGER,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', session_config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    );
ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN transcript_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE routines ADD COLUMN revision INTEGER
ALTER TABLE routines ADD COLUMN sync_definition TEXT
